svg.title: Step 6: a normal day
svg.desc: The admin sits relaxed in a chair with a drink. The machine hums with its lights on and three small gear icons above it for running apps. Its safe door carries a green open padlock, with a circular arrow around it and the label Restart: opens itself. A wall calendar on the right shows 30 days with the first days crossed off, far from the end. The banner says Most days: nothing to do.
